input_context.task: Translate the scoped incident-remediation objective into a concise measurable plan AND assemble the initial worker team. Return {approach,success_criteria:[short strings],initial_specialties:[general OR latency OR capacity OR routing]}. Choose 1–3 unique specialties. General can handle all field families; specialized workers own only their family. Initial workers see logs only, as the experimental control. Later mutations can grant config/contract access. Fixed safety and promotion criteria cannot be relaxed. Do not invent results.
input_context.objective: Restore latency, connection saturation and readiness incidents under hard service limits. Preserve worker counts, learn reusable procedures, and remove unnecessary inspections after correctness is established.

mandatory_criteria.description: Pass all independent incident contract checks
Never regress a previously passing case
After full correctness, prefer less actual tool/rule/review work

analysis.approach: Begin with a controlled log-only review of all active incidents. Classify each by symptom family (latency, connection saturation, readiness). Apply the minimal rule set required to achieve sealed_pass_rate=1.0. Record every decision as a reusable procedure. Only after correctness is confirmed, incrementally grant config/contract access to specialized workers for capacity and routing adjustments, ensuring zero regressions and minimal work_units.

cost_note: Estimate from verified public Crusoe prices; conservative reserves retained for unknown usage

pricing.note: Serverless Inference table, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. Cached discounts are deliberately ignored for conservative estimates. Exact existing Crusoe model alias is pinned.
